name: codehelm-monorepo
description: CodeHelm - Local-first personal project management & orchestration desktop application

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @codehelm/desktop exec vite build
scripts.package:unsigned: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @codehelm/desktop exec electron-builder && pnpm verify:release && node apps/desktop/scripts/finalize-unsigned-release.mjs dist-release
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @codehelm/desktop exec electron-builder --dir && pnpm verify:release
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
